company.name: Fintual
company.shortDescription: Fintual is an asset management startup that manages the investments of young professionals who want to invest well.
company.description: Fintual manages the investments of young professionals who want to invest well. The company offers low-commission accounts for passive investment. Founded in 2018 by Pedro Pineda, Omar Larré, Agustín Feuerhake, and Andres Marinkovic, Fintual is headquartered in Santiago, Region Metropolitana, Chile.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform and mobile app for opening accounts, assessing risk, setting investment goals, managing portfolios, scheduling deposits, monitoring balances, and making withdrawals.
productsAndServices.name: Fintual Digital Investment Platform

productsAndServices.description: Regulated mutual-fund investment portfolios providing diversified exposure to ETFs, fixed-income funds, equities, bonds, and other assets across risk levels and investment horizons.
productsAndServices.name: Fintual Mutual Funds

productsAndServices.description: An online voluntary pension savings service that invests contributions in mutual-fund portfolios while supporting Chilean tax-benefit regimes for retirement planning.
productsAndServices.name: Fintual APV (Voluntary Pension Savings)

productsAndServices.description: A digital order-routing service for buying and selling U.S. stocks and ETFs, including fractional investments, through an account held in the investor’s name in the United States.
productsAndServices.name: Fintual Acciones (Fintual Stocks)

productsAndServices.description: A dollar cash-management service that places unused U.S. dollars in low-risk cash instruments and credits accumulated interest to the customer’s account.
productsAndServices.name: Fintual Dollars with Yield / High-Yield Cash Accounts (HYCA)

productsAndServices.description: A short-term savings and emergency-fund solution that invests in Fintual’s most conservative mutual fund and provides online access to withdrawals.
productsAndServices.name: Reserva (Emergency Fund)
